title: CAN Transmit
text: Transmit CAN message to selected CAN device, 1 input; {Device} sets the cAN device and channel, {Transmit Options: On data change} enables event-based transmission when data, {Transmit Options: Periodic} enables periodic transmission and {Transmit Options: Message period} sets the period of message transmission rate. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: CAN Msg
ports.summary: CAN message to transmit packed CAN message

params.name: Device
params.values: CAN device and channel list option

params.name: Transmit Options: On data change
params.values: Enable event-based transmission when data changes ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Transmit Options: Message period
params.values: Period of message transmission rate 1.000 (default) | positive numeric scalar
